tasks.title: Re-run gamefilm film+battle to remake the 46 critique films, then land the branch
tasks.why: decisions.md:197 (R0 C1) names three deliverables for this unit: the camera keeps its subject, a check in the filming tool fails a film that loses it, and the 46 films are made again. The first two hold: FilmAim/TacticalCamera.HoldAuto fix the bearing math (FilmFollowTests covers worked numbers, not a tautology), and gamefilm.py's new check() / check_trace() exits 1 on LOST SUBJECT, STILL, FROM BEHIND and NO SUBJECT, wired into film()/battle() so a bad take fails the run (test_assetboard.py:gamefilm_cases, 18 cases, exercised against hand-written traces). The third is missing: no assetfilm folder or trace exists anywhere reachable (not in this checkout's Captures/, not in tw3d-board-2); the branch's own commit message only reports a single manual Mercy batch run, not the 46-film critique set. Landing without the re-film leaves the owner's own standing complaint (19 of 46 scored, none checked) unresolved even though the tool that would check them is ready. Cost of not doing this: the fixed camera and check sit idle, and the owner's next review page waits on nothing being re-filmed. The merge onto integration (236 commits ahead) is otherwise clean except one text conflict in docs/reference/tasks.md (both sides added rows), which the landing session resolves by hand per CLAUDE.md.
tasks.done_when: `python Tools/assetboard/gamefilm.py up`, `film`, `battle`, `down` have run on lane/show/anim-critique (rebased), `python Tools/assetboard/gamefilm.py check` reports 46 films checked with 0 fails (or named, fixed fails), and the branch lands via Tools/land.py
